source_theorem.work: Dmitry Sokolov, Pseudorandom Generators, Resolution and Heavy Width, CCC 2022
source_theorem.role: external Resolution lower bound for the full functional Nisan-Wigderson encoding
source_theorem.parameter_regime: m=n^(2-delta), Delta=log^(2-delta)n, balanced base functions, suitable random NW graph with high probability

direct_family.name: DIRPARITY(G,b)
direct_family.parameter_map: log N_n = O(log^(2-delta)n), hence exp(n^Omega(delta)) is superpolynomial in N_n

restricted_proof_system.name: NW-neighborhood-local B2/ER3
restricted_proof_system.admission: for every extension e<->(a AND b), support(a) union support(b) is contained in one fixed NW neighborhood Vars_i
restricted_proof_system.er3: every Resolution-derived non-axiom clause has width <=3

transfer.extension_variable_map: e -> y_g_e for the recursively computed local Boolean function g_e
transfer.semantic_aliasing: allowed; ordinary Resolution is polynomially closed under literal substitutions/variable identification

derived_theorems.L1E_1: Every NW-neighborhood-local B2 refutation of the direct parity-NW family has superpolynomial size in the actual direct input length N_n.
derived_theorems.L1E_2: For every fixed c, all sufficiently large family members require K>N_n^c extension variables in every NW-neighborhood-local ER3 refutation.

provider_replay.workflow: Validate C025 Fair Scheduler and Reasons

not_proved: superpolynomial extension count for unrestricted ER3
claim_ceiling: This is a derived restriction-only theorem using an external heavy-width lower bound plus an internal proof transfer and input-length map. Global Issue #217 and P vs NP remain open.
